notes.title: Small patch fixing some issues
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

Thank you for those that give any kind of feedback on the game, it is extremely appreicated and it helps me more than you could ever know!
This is just a small patch to improve the gameplay and fix some issues you have mentioned, bigger update still to come.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

- Added research cancel button
- Cut research by around 50%
- Cut building times by around 50%
- Increased production speeds by around 25%
- On invasions seekers will now stop what they are doing to attack the invaders (To be improved in the future combat update)
- Slightly reduced the invaders in invasions to be less destructive (To be improved as well)
- Added ladder remove tool
- ESC now closes most menus correctly
- Improved hotkey logic to be smoother
- Disabled moving the camera with WASD while in pause menu
- Fixed issue were some players were unable to have more than one save slot
- Increased bottom menu size a bit for better readability
- Improved edge scroll by adding delay to bottom of the screen
- Added graphic settings for chromatic abberattion and film grain
- Increased movement speed of all seekers by around 40%
- UI text improvements
- Fixed game speed multiplier resetting on pause/events

Next update will be related to combat, turrets, raids variety and more, stay tuned :P

notes.title: Version 1.0 Is LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

It's been a while, but finally Mission: Rift Seeker is leaving Steam Early Access with a huge update!
Heres a new Trailer for 1.0 Release
[previewyoutube=MW9U14kzL4c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

New:
- Shortcuts for menu's to make the gameplay smoother

- Event log, displaying 25 latests events
- 14 New entities of varying grades, heres just some of them:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/df15ad2333dd9cc05bd711773f266c8e8636376f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/6fdc858b76c49684ab0cfd026d3c4de9a114293e.jpg[/img]
- Seekers now have their status effects shown as emojis over their heads, allowing to notice issues more quickly
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/a481a6a4c125fc05bae1d6a4856e8578e829a13c.jpg[/img]
- Ability to move seekers manually, giving you a chance to run away from entities or cancel unwated orders if managed quickly
- New "Deer" Seeker
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/7b3209101187465a075afca855cfe804f99f8fe8.jpg[/img]
- Entities now have a higher chance to break out, depending on their sanity and hunger

Updates:
- Saves reflect time better
- Balancing some damage to health and sanity while interacting with entities
- Destroyed buildings now drop half the required resources, allowing for more balanced building
- Adjusted post processing for each of the planets to make them more atmospheric
- Building production and entity consumtion balancing
- UI changes, font sizing to fit better, description updates and more
- Increased event rate and added some harder ones depending on planet difficulty
- Increased exploration time for better progression


Fixes:
- Some menus not closing when they should properly
- Some death animations not showing up properly
- Some animations for large entities not showing up correctly
- Dirt being very scarce in 2 of the planets
- Camera not being movable when paused in some cases
- Autosaves sometimes overwriting manual saves
- Some items not showing up properly or having incorrect icons
- Building beam poppin glitch

I am super excited to have reached this far as a Solo developer, even though Mission: Rift Seeker hasn't been very popular so far, I am Thankful for those that play my games and I hope to continue creating more in the future! :)

OneManGames

notes.title: The "Worlds" update
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

Time for a big update again! Hope you all are as excited as I am. 
Yey for lots of new content!

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

- Added world options to the start of the game, allowing 2 new worlds! With their own difficulties!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/ff50f80a788ae3798bc1b5a8bce00eb0f4d2dbd3.jpg[/img]
- Improved the first world to have better and more resources
- New events for each world
- Added a TON of new weather to the all worlds with gameplay effects ;P
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/712162cc6498e25977d670a54fafbcae55571ca9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/56caa3a45619d2bb2d33b322f978b43ed39b324e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/7ebbe575864e1baa8392f53887dbab56641053c8.jpg[/img]
- New game start options that allows players to choose what kind of challenge they want in their game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/328bb1406dd5c12922d7a98be08229d4d7e2e161.jpg[/img]
- New demon seeker race [Rare]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/4f46feb8c99663d0a1e14594ac6364fdf1561492.jpg[/img]
- New mouse starter race
- New option for 12/24 hour clock
- New buildings: Ice bin and infuser
- Ranch can now produce feathers
- Improved and changed mouse drag for smoother camera movement
- Status effect balancing
- 5 New creatures (Now totalling 46!): Owlbat, Crimson reflection, Mr pyramid, astronaut, dust crab


More updated to come in the future :)

notes.title: The "Bull" update
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

Time for an update! Sadly didn't manage to push out all the wanted changes fast enough, so the next update will be bigger, but I did add some fun stuff for you all to enjoy :P

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[h3]New[/h3]
- New [b]Bull[/b] seeker race
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/1a0a50c9e43d8c8a5cc67a22de2dcb50e981b875.jpg[/img]
- New buildings [b]Transmission receiver[/b] and [b]Life extractor[/b] both with their own mechanics and logic for you to figure out ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/68d49faee65ef8abb430e7f5cfcb283141be44c9.jpg[/img]
- New item concentrated blood
- 3 New creatures, Small - muddlet, medium - Bloodline coffin, large - Drifting rook
- Added a hint in main menu for leaving a review <3
- New extra "spooky" post processing effects for atmosphere
- Side missions that happen randomly
- Cavern event while exploring (With its own sub plots)

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Updated seeker face animations to work better for different races
- Changed death animations to look much better for different races
- Changes to some entities about what they eat and produce for balancing
- Increased the invasion portal power a bit and increased the chances of invasions happening
- Increased mining time for balancing

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed issues with fish tank
- Fixed issues with smelter lighting
- UI fixes, tooltips now properly show research requirements
- Fixed some items having incorrect icons
- Other small bug fixes

Thats all for now, more to come in the next update, let me know what your thoughts are, here or on discord :P

notes.title: Patch 0.02a
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

As promirsed heres the first patch of many, adding some much needed gameplay improvements and some small content additions, just a small step towards making the game as amazing as it should be.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[h3]New[/h3]
- Added more research nodes available to increase seeker population count to [b]70[/b]
- Added simple incursion events with strength depending on your overall outpost value and seeker count

Void incursion portal spawning randomly:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/52fb2cb0f342d74155d9941b6ce3a781b6ce3d94.jpg[/img]

Mechanoid hive invaders:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/ddb1d3649a62fed2aafca2f7cf6060a721a64b35.jpg[/img]

- Added save deletion confirmation to protect your precious moments from miss clicks

- More statistics, added seeker average happiness, health and sanity, entity average happiness, hunger and sanity statistics to help keep track of whats going on in your outpost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900826/6fdf32e0929507087a2c8857f4812b7537838ab0.jpg[/img]

- New autosave functionality with a setting to choose from 5/10/30 minute interval for autosaving or have no autosave at all for those that want a more hardcore experience
- 2 new special entities for the void incursions, hive bulldog and hive drone, currently not available to be captured.
- Added a couple more seeker clothing styles for more variety
- 3 New decorations: Tree sign, danger sign, rocket statue
- Patch notes button in main menu for easy access

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Updated game resolutions to work better for borderless windows
- Balancing changes for entity escape and aggressivness for all entities
- Entities now correctly prioritize attacking the closest target
- Removed ability to destroy the base landing pad and gatherables around the world, you can still gather them normally

Thats all for now, more to come next week, let me know what your thoughts are, here or on discord :P
